errors.advance_release_kind_required: Say whether a gate decision or a condition releases this advance package.
errors.advance_release_not_found: The releasing gate decision or condition was not found in this project.
errors.advance_without_reason: An advance package needs a reason.
errors.binding_requires_change_request: The concept is binding. Change it through a change request on the frame document.
errors.candidate_exists: This company is already a candidate for the package.
errors.candidate_needs_company: Name the company or link a subcontractor or vendor.
errors.candidate_not_registered: Register the company as subcontractor or vendor before short-listing it.
errors.concept_has_blocking_findings: The concept has findings that block approval.
errors.concept_locked: The concept is under review or approved. Return or reopen it to change the plan.
errors.concept_missing: This project has no procurement concept yet.
errors.criterion_not_in_profile: The criterion is not part of the package's prequalification profile.
errors.criterion_unknown: The criterion is not in the pinned catalogue.
errors.document_not_found: Governance document not found in this project.
errors.excluded_candidate_without_rationale: Give a reason for excluding the candidate.
errors.execution_exists: The package already has an execution link.
errors.framework_code_exists: A framework agreement with this code exists.
errors.framework_dates_inverted: The end date is before the start date.
errors.framework_exhausted: The framework agreement has not enough value left.
errors.framework_not_active: The framework agreement is not active.
errors.invalid_transition: This step is not possible in the current state.
errors.jurisdiction_not_in_catalogue: The pinned catalogue does not define this jurisdiction.
errors.no_schedule: The project has no schedule to write the milestones to.
errors.no_tenant: No company context for this request.
errors.not_procurement_owner: Only a project manager or the owner of the procurement area can do this.
errors.package_closed: The package is in tender, awarded or cancelled.
errors.package_kind_not_procured: This package kind is not procured as an award package.
errors.package_not_on_hold: The package is not on hold.
errors.package_plan_unavailable: The package plan of the delivery model is not available.
errors.package_without_procedure_plan: Every contract package needs an award package with a procedure.
errors.pass_fail_takes_no_score: A pass or fail criterion takes no score.
errors.prequal_weights_not_100: The weights of the scored criteria must add up to 100.
errors.procedure_unknown: The procedure is not in the pinned catalogue.
errors.schedule_needs_need_date_and_procedure: The package needs a need date and a procedure.
errors.shortlist_invalid: The short list does not meet the rules.
errors.vehicle_not_allowed_for_kind: A request for quotation is only for supply packages.

evidence.concept_ready: Procurement concept approved without blocking findings

findings.advance_package_not_released: Advance package not released by a gate decision or condition
findings.award_schedule_infeasible: Procurement would have to start in the past or before the releasing gate
findings.design_package_uses_works_rules: Design package uses works rules instead of services
findings.framework_exhausted: Framework agreement has not enough value left
findings.framework_expired: Framework agreement ends before the planned award
findings.framework_procedure_mismatch: Package on a framework must use a call-off or mini competition
findings.framework_scope_mismatch: Framework agreement does not cover this package kind
findings.lot_splitting_avoids_threshold: Lots split below the threshold; the aggregated value is above it
findings.need_date_missing: No need date for the award schedule
findings.prequal_evidence_expires_before_award: Prequalification evidence expires before the planned award
findings.procedure_inconsistent_with_delivery_for: Procedure does not fit the delivery form
findings.procedure_not_allowed_above_threshold: Procedure not allowed at this value
findings.shortlist_below_min_bidders: Fewer short-listed companies than the procedure needs
findings.split_form_without_trade_packages: Trade-split delivery form with a single works package
findings.tender_basis_not_allowed: Tender basis not allowed for this procedure
findings.threshold_currency_unresolved: No conversion rate into the threshold currency
findings.threshold_source_unconfirmed: Threshold not yet confirmed on its primary source

rules.advance_package_released_fix: Link the gate decision or condition that releases it.
rules.award_schedule_feasible_fix: Move the need date, shorten the procedure or make it an advance package.
rules.capacity_risk_mitigated_fix: Record a mitigation or re-split the package.
rules.excluded_candidate_has_rationale_fix: Give the reason for the exclusion.
rules.framework_call_off_valid_fix: Choose an active framework with value left.
rules.lots_aggregated_for_threshold: Package {ref}: lots aggregated for the threshold
rules.lots_aggregated_for_threshold_fix: Use the procedure for the aggregated value or a valid small-lots exemption.
rules.package_has_procedure_plan_fix: Create the award package and choose a procedure.
rules.procedure_allowed_for_value: Package {ref}: procedure allowed for the value
rules.procedure_allowed_for_value_fix: Choose a procedure the threshold check allows.
rules.procedure_consistent_with_delivery_form_: Adjust the tender basis or the number of stages.
rules.shortlist_min_bidders_fix: Add qualified companies to the short list.
rules.threshold_source_confirmed_fix: Check the threshold on its primary source.
